I had a very disappointing experience with Banfield Pet Hospital. I initially paid $218 to enroll in their Active Care plan during my first visit, but it was never clearly explained to me that this was a 1-year contract. There was no transparency about the long-term commitment or the financial obligation I was signing up for.

On top of that, when I decided to cancel, I was charged an additional $361 just to get out of the contract. Altogether, I ended up paying nearly $600 just to have my cat diagnosed with hyperthyroidism. That’s an outrageous amount for such a basic service, especially when I could have gone to another veterinary clinic for far less.

This experience felt extremely misleading and frustrating. I would not have signed up if the terms had been clearly explained upfront. I strongly recommend others fully understand what they’re agreeing to before enrolling, or consider going to a different vet altogether.
Thanks for trusting us with your BFF 🧡 We appreciate the review! …

They misdiagnosed my dog not using his back leg as a torn tendon. Another vet figured out it was valley fever. I think my cat had valley fever too, but misdiagnosed her with stomach cancer due to a growth. She had valley fever symptoms and no cancer symptoms. I was new to Phoenix so I didn't realize to ask for a test for valley fever. Once I knew my dog had valley fever, they provided short term medicine. I had to switch vets to get proper treatment. I don't know why they ignore valley fever when it's so common. Now, my cat is dead, and since I've researched valley fever symptoms, I realize what she had.

The staff at this clinic has always been friendly and professional, but my experience with the clinic’s policies and continuity of care has been challenging.

I first brought my dog in for allergy issues and was prescribed Apoquel. I was told it was safe and effective, with no mention of any required testing. Later, when I attempted to refill the prescription, I was informed that a blood test was required to ensure the medication wasn’t causing harm. This test cost multiple hundreds of dollars. The results were normal, and I was approved for several months of refills.

When I tried to refill the medication again, the request was denied—not for medical reasons, but because a different doctor, who had never seen my dog, was on duty. I was told I needed another appointment before they would authorize the refill. During this delay, my dog’s symptoms worsened and led to an infection.

At the follow-up appointment, the new doctor performed another full exam even though an established plan was documented by the previous doctor. I was told this was standard for a new provider. The infection was addressed, but the allergy treatment plan was reset to the exact same dosage and schedule that had already been documented as ineffective. I asked about adjusting the dosage based on the prior doctor’s notes, but was told the provider wanted to restart from the beginning.

At this point, I have seen three different doctors from the same location, each restarting the evaluation rather than continuing or adjusting the documented treatment plan.

When I asked about continuity of care, management explained that the clinic has only one regular doctor, and when that doctor is unavailable, clients cannot choose their provider. This structure leads to repeated costs, inconsistent decisions, and difficulty maintaining steady progress on a treatment plan.

The staff has consistently been kind and professional, but the policies and lack of provider continuity have made follow-up care, prescription management, and treatment adjustments very difficult.

This vet was recommended by a friend and I have brought my dog here regularly since early 2020. This location as well as their other locations has proven to be phenomenal in pet healthcare. We have our pet on the care plan and not only is it easy and convenient to have all of her vaccinations prepaid, she gets regular teeth cleaning included. I doubt my dog would get the regular care she deserves without this plan and the staff keeping in touch. Appointments  for all follow up and continued visits are just the only way to go so that my dog is always up to date. This plan also saved her life when she ate something random and it blocked her bowels. Banfield staff at 3 separate locations all worked together to find emergency care for her to have surgery. Affordable payment advice, comfort, and support is the reason my fur baby Xena is still with us today! I wouldn't trust my pets anywhere else!
